full_prompt_en: A square romantic storybook illustration shows a golden-curled girl in side view, holding a small white mouse close to her face among enormous ivory flowers. The composition is packed edge to edge with hair, petals, and curling stems, yet the girl's pale profile remains a clear focal point near the center-right. Her eyes are closed and her cheeks carry a soft pink blush. Long honey-gold curls sweep outward across the left half, threaded with a dark blue bow and delicate filigree strands. She wears a deep blue puff-sleeved dress edged in muted green, its folds modeled with fine directional lines. Both hands support the mouse under its chest; the animal stretches upward with a tiny pink nose, dark beadlike eye, rounded ears, and pale fur that almost merges with the surrounding blossoms. Large white flowers open at the top, right, and lower left, their centers and petals drawn with fine gray-green outlines and warm cream shading. Twisting blue-green leaves and vines weave behind the figures, mixed with pale ochre ornamental curls and faint patterned areas. There is no distant view or realistic setting; overlapping botanical shapes create a shallow enclosed world. The medium appears to mix fine ink drawing with translucent watercolor or colored-pencil washes. Individual hair strands, petal veins, fabric seams, and small fur marks remain visible, while broad areas stay soft and light. Illumination is diffuse and gentle, with pale paper white serving as the brightest value and no hard cast shadows. The palette balances honey gold and pink against indigo, teal-green, ivory, and warm cream. The image feels tender and intricately made, its close encounter sheltered inside a dense, pale floral framework.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浪漫绘本插画呈现一名金卷发女孩的侧脸，她在硕大的象牙白花之间，把一只小白鼠捧到面前。构图从边到边填满头发、花瓣和卷曲茎枝，女孩浅色侧脸仍在中右附近成为清楚焦点。她闭着眼，脸颊带柔粉红晕。长蜂蜜金卷发向外扫过左半幅，夹着深蓝蝴蝶结与精巧花丝般的发束。她穿深蓝泡泡袖裙，边饰暗绿，衣褶由细定向线塑形。双手在鼠胸下托住它；小动物向上伸，粉色小鼻、深珠眼、圆耳与浅毛几乎融进周围花朵。大白花在顶部、右侧和左下开放，花心与花瓣由细灰绿轮廓和暖奶油色阴影描出。弯曲蓝绿叶与藤蔓在人物后交织，混着淡赭装饰卷纹和浅图案区域。没有远景或写实场所；植物形状的叠压建立浅薄围合的世界。媒介似乎结合细墨线与透明水彩或色铅水洗。单根发丝、花瓣脉、衣缝与小毛痕仍可见，宽阔区域则柔和轻浅。光漫射而温柔，纸白作为最亮明度，没有硬投影。配色以蜂蜜金与粉红对照靛蓝、青绿、象牙白和暖奶油。图像温柔且制作精密，近距离相遇被藏在密集而浅亮的花形框架里。
style_prompt_en: A romantic storybook treatment combines extremely fine ink contours and hairline filigree with translucent watercolorlike or colored-pencil shading. Honey gold and pale pink gather around a small focal area, countered by deep indigo, blue-green foliage tones, and extensive ivory-white petal shapes. Long curling lines sweep across one side and weave into large rounded organic forms on the other, enclosing the center without a distant horizon. Many small parallel marks describe strands, veins, folds, and soft texture; broad washes remain light and slightly grainy. Pale paper areas serve as active highlights, while muted olive and warm cream prevent the whites from feeling blank. Diffuse illumination makes contours and material detail visible without sharp cast shadow. The surface feels carefully hand-made and decorative but not rigid, with intricate edge work softened by gentle value transitions. The composition is intimate and lush, balancing a dense looping frame with a quiet, clearly lit center.
style_prompt_zh: 浪漫绘本处理将极细墨线轮廓与发丝般装饰线网，结合透明水彩般或色铅般的柔和上色。蜂蜜金与浅粉聚在一小片焦点区域，由深靛蓝、蓝绿叶色和大量象牙白花瓣形体对照。长卷线扫过一侧，与另一侧大型圆浑有机形状交织，围住中心而不出现远地平线。许多细小平行记号描述丝线、脉纹、褶层和柔软纹理；宽阔水洗色保持轻浅且略有颗粒。浅纸色区域作为积极高光，暗橄榄绿与暖奶油色使白色不显空。漫射光让轮廓与材质细节可见，却没有尖锐投影。表面有谨慎手工和装饰感，但不僵硬，复杂边缘处理被温和明暗过渡柔化。构图亲密而繁茂，在密集回旋外框与安静、清楚受光的中心之间平衡。
theme_en: A golden-curled girl holding a small white mouse among large ivory flowers
theme_zh: 金色卷发女孩在象牙色大花间捧着一只白鼠
name: Lisi Martin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
